ssm.reason: Full report contains personal identity numbers/home addresses and financial data; page1 QR may allow access to full report. Public summary only.

presentation.prompt: Portrait 4:5 decorative empty certificate gallery backdrop, dark industrial navy, cyan edge lighting and angular corner slash accents, faint industrial piping; clean central 80%; no certificate, text, logos, seals, signatures, QR or paper.
presentation.implementation: Use original certificate image object-fit:contain above decorative CSS background with 5–7% padding, no cropping; title/expiry in selectable HTML below. Open full image/PDF on click. Three actual certificates plus separate SSM corporate-summary card. Never label SSM report as a certificate.
